item.title: JPA Approves Over 13,000 New Positions For Health Workers
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)

Amid 15,587 existing nursing vacancies, MOH must hire over 19,000 nurses, likely to take eight years by 2034, assuming no one quits.
